evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story in the backlog expresses the same requirement for creating a game with name/description and inviting estimators; distinct actor and goal.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the specific requirement to invite via a URL.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Unique requirement describing starting a round with a single multi-line input; no duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-specific view of current-session items; other stories about listing items have different actors or scopes.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: This moderator action is distinct; although related stories mention re-estimation, none earlier duplicate this selection capability.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique requirement to add items; no other story identically specifies this add capability.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item is a distinct requirement from adding/deleting/selecting items.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deletion of items is a distinct operation; no other story duplicates this exact need.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Specific moderator ability to show estimates immediately (even if not all provided) is different from other reveal/timing stories.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average as the agreed estimate is a distinct business rule not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automatic-fill behavior for unanimous cards is a distinct feature; no other story requires the same automatic action.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of the agreed estimate is different from automated acceptance rules and thus unique.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in PP-005 which already permits selecting an item to be estimated or re-estimated; no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Specific import-from-spreadsheet mechanism is a distinct requirement compared to other bulk-add methods.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste as a distinct bulk entry method differs from explicit import; not treated as a duplicate under the uniqueness rule.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is distinct from viewing/exporting/deleting individual games.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a game transcript is distinct from exporting or browsing games.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export-as-HTML is a distinct output requirement from viewing or exporting-to-CSV.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export-as-CSV is a distinct export format requirement; not a duplicate of viewing/exporting-to-HTML.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion is a unique operation; no other story duplicates deleting games.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is distinct from login, edit, delete, and password reminder stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is a distinct requirement separate from account creation and management.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account modification is unique compared to create/delete/login/password stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is a distinct requirement and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display requirement is unique and not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder by email is a distinct account recovery feature.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Choice of estimation scales is a specific configuration requirement and unique.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Specific limit on invitations is a distinct business rule not found in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Estimator join flow is distinct from moderator invite flow and other user actions.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Estimator view of the current item is distinct from moderator selection and session-wide lists.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator-specific desire to view all session items differs from moderator's similar story by actor.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Immediate presence indicator for estimates is distinct from other visibility and reveal stories.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reveal when all have voted is distinct from immediate/manual reveal options.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Allows changing estimate until reveal; this exact timing semantics is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing per-estimator prior estimates for the story is a specific history feature not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing who gave which estimates in the current round is distinct from presence indicators or historical views.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Ability to start a shared timer is unique compared to timer reset or other features.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset behavior is a distinct timer requirement; not duplicated by start-timer story.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Navigation through prior rounds' stories/estimates is a distinct feature from viewing transcripts or per-estimator history.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering consistency is a distinct UI requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Substantially the same as PP-034 which already allows changing until the last person selects and reveal; no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: UI personalization via thumbnail is a unique requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance for markup/CSS is a distinct developer requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/definitions requirement is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Technical developer task to create indexes is distinct from user-facing performance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Legacy-browser compatibility is a distinct developer requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a distinct non-functional requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: General responsiveness requirement is unique compared to specific implementation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a distinct internationalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is a distinct usability requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page design is a distinct UX requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data anonymization requirement for research data is unique and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics/analytics requirement is distinct from storage/anonymization and other features.
